issues.description: Module-import-time monkey-patch of genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE mutates third-party private state globally
issues.detail: Setting genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE = 5*1024*1024 at import reaches into a private SDK attribute, creating a process-wide side effect for every google-genai consumer. It will silently break when the underscore-prefixed name changes upstream. Configure via the SDK's public HttpOptions/client surface or file an upstream fix; do not ship a confessed 'temporary hack' as load-bearing import behavior.

issues.description: image.tobytes() pushed as format='RGB' without converting PIL mode produces corrupted pixels
issues.detail: PIL opens images in whatever mode the source declares (often RGBA or P for generated PNGs). Calling image.tobytes() yields bytes in that mode while the OutputImageRawFrame is labeled format='RGB', so byte length and pixel layout disagree and downstream renderers read garbage. Call image.convert('RGB') before tobytes(), or propagate image.mode as the declared frame format.

issues.description: Silent default model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash shifts behavior for existing callers
issues.detail: Bumping the default model changes latency, pricing, thinking-budget behavior, and output for every caller that relied on the prior default. The constructor signature offers no deprecation path, and the change is folded into an unrelated feature PR. Separate it into its own change with a migration note, or stage it behind a deprecation.

issues.description: Image-model detection via substring 'image' in model name is a fragile capability proxy
issues.detail: _maybe_unset_thinking_budget gates on `'image' in self._model_name`, encoding a Google naming convention as an invariant. Future models like gemini-3-vision or gemini-3-image-aware silently regress the budget logic. Extract an explicit predicate (e.g., is_image_generation_model()) backed by a documented capability table.

issues.description: Inline image data has no size bound, MIME check, or error handling and can crash _process_context
issues.detail: part.inline_data.data is unconditionally read into BytesIO and PIL with no try/except, MIME-type check, or upper bound. A malformed payload, non-image inline_data, or oversized blob raises UnidentifiedImageError or exhausts memory, killing the context loop. Add a guard, inspect mime_type, and bound the payload.

issues.description: Emitting OutputImageRawFrame from GoogleLLMService extends the service's output contract without restating it
issues.detail: The supertype contract is text+tool-call streaming; pushing image frames mid-stream strengthens what downstream pipelines must accept. Consumers wired against the prior LLM service interface may not handle image frames. Document which model classes emit which frame types and the ordering guarantees relative to LLMTextFrame and aggregator boundaries.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on two must-fix defects: a module-import-time monkey-patch of google-genai's private READ_BUFFER_SIZE that mutates third-party state process-wide, and an image-decoding path that labels PIL bytes as RGB without converting modes, producing corrupted pixels. Secondary issues are also unanimous: the silent default-model bump to gemini-2.5-flash is a behavioral contract change buried in a feature PR, and substring-matching 'image' in the model name is a fragile capability proxy. Additional concerns include the absence of any size bound or error handling on inline image data and an unstated extension of the LLM service's output frame contract. The fixes are small but should land before merge.
